model: Selected finite H: ADM point-mass 1PN + LO SO + Newton rotor kinetic energy and Q2, one oriented figure
initial_frame: Single Newtonian centroid translation and canonical mass-weighted momentum shift at t=0, fixed thereafter. No TDB/JPL epoch; synthetic ADM frame.
scaling: Initial x/p/S norms per body, all nonzero; q and R entries unit absolute scale; compare attitudes as matrices. P drift divided by sum |p0|. Point-spin norms invariant; figure-spin norm is NOT invariant.
power_scale: At initial state: sum over bodies of |Hx_i|*|xdot_i|+|Hp_i|*|pdot_i|+|Hs_i|*|Sdot_i|, plus |Htheta|*|Wfigure|; must be nonzero, no epsilon
angular_rate_scale: Initial |J0| divided by nominal period, strictly positive
interpretation: Conservative closure of a selected mixed Hamiltonian, not all GR PN quadrupole terms or a physical lunar model. No PN inertia/mass-energy redefinition, boost algebra, Q2-Q2, Q4, spin-spin, NLO SO, core, deformation, tide or fit. Mixed products generated by the exact flow are kept but do not certify omitted physical PN-figure terms.
